title: Result ingestion lanes
description: Bounded admission lane queue depth, throughput, rejections, NACKs, crashes, and incomplete sync runs across serviceradar-core nodes.

panels.title: Queue depth (items)
panels.srql_query: in:timeseries_metrics metric_type:core.result_ingestion metric_name:(result_ingestion_pending_count,result_ingestion_in_flight_count) time:last_1h bucket:1m agg:avg series:metric_name limit:500

display_config.caption: Pending and in-flight item occupancy across bounded core ingestion lanes.

panels.title: Queue depth (bytes)
panels.srql_query: in:timeseries_metrics metric_type:core.result_ingestion metric_name:(result_ingestion_pending_bytes,result_ingestion_in_flight_bytes) time:last_1h bucket:1m agg:avg series:metric_name limit:500

display_config.caption: Pending and in-flight byte occupancy across bounded core ingestion lanes.

panels.title: Admitted vs rejected counters
panels.srql_query: in:timeseries_metrics metric_type:core.result_ingestion metric_name:(result_ingestion_events_admitted,result_ingestion_events_rejected) time:last_1h bucket:1m agg:avg series:metric_name limit:500

display_config.caption: Admitted and rejected interval deltas published by RuntimeMetrics on metrics.ingestion_lanes.

panels.title: Completions, NACKs, crashes & incomplete sync runs
panels.srql_query: in:timeseries_metrics metric_type:core.result_ingestion metric_name:(result_ingestion_terminals_accepted,result_ingestion_terminals_not_accepted,result_ingestion_events_crash,result_ingestion_events_incomplete_run) time:last_1h bucket:1m agg:avg series:metric_name limit:500

display_config.caption: Non-zero not_accepted or incomplete_run deltas indicate downstream persistence failures or incomplete sync runs.

panels.title: Admission wait & execution latency (ms)
panels.srql_query: in:timeseries_metrics metric_type:core.result_ingestion metric_name:(result_ingestion_queue_wait_ms,result_ingestion_execution_ms,result_ingestion_acknowledgement_ms) time:last_1h bucket:1m agg:avg series:metric_name limit:500

display_config.caption: Queue wait, worker execution, and end-to-end acknowledgement duration gauges.
Latest per-lane metric samples persisted from metrics.ingestion_lanes.
